name: ${NAME}
description: P3B-H fidelity sweep on the scorer v2 of P3B-B (ADR 0009), a copy of fid-v2.template.json with the crossfade as a variable (${CROSSFADE_MS} ms): the voice in ${SLOT} on ${EP}, ${PITCH} F0, 40 ms engine blocks on the voice changer's default 512-frame device block, ${EXTRA_MS} ms extra context, ${LOOKAHEAD_MS} ms lookahead, the ${PRESET} preset, the clip ${CLIP}. The clip is scored at three absolute offsets (leads that are not multiples of the block, so the anchored-noise realisation and the block phase change), against ceiling A (long shape, the primary: the v1 metrics), ceiling B and the whole-utterance ceiling (a v2 run renders all three for a template voice), with the floors (ceiling A against itself with its blocks shifted by 100 ms, with another noise seed, and against ceiling B) and, with SIGIL_BENCH_ABLATIONS=1 (run_corpus.ps1 -Analyzer v2+ablations), the oracle ablations. REFERENCE_CLIPS_JSON lists the target-speaker set (other clips' whole-ceiling renditions; [] = none). Materialized by run_corpus.ps1.
